QuestInfo.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Advice
QuestInfo.0: I need to seek advice from #p203# on behalf of #p206# in #m10001000#.
QuestInfo.1: #p203# in #m10001000# advised that it is crucial for #p206# to convey his true feelings to his daughter, and suggested that preparing a homemade dish for her would be a great idea. Since #p206# isn't good at cooking, she asked me to deliver a recipe for a dish that #p506# would love.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I delivered the recipe written by #p203# to #p206#.

0.0: That's right... Losing #p506# when she was still just a young child was 7 years ago, which means she must be a teenage girl now. Finding his daughter is wonderful news, but one cannot simply ignore all those years they spent living apart.
0.1: Besides, a girl at that age must have so many worries, and without a mother around, it’s understandable that opening up to a father she only just reunited with wouldn't come easily. Plus, if she lived in #m10004000# for so long, everything here in #m10001000# must feel unfamiliar to her. Hmm... What should be done...
0.2: I know! When it comes to conveying one's feelings, actions are always best. If #p506# can truly feel how much her father loves her, she might just open her heart. Why doesn't #p206# try cooking a meal for his daughter himself? Sometimes, a heartfelt dish communicates your feelings far better than words ever could.
0.3: Though I'm almost certain #p206# is terrible at cooking. Goodness, he barely even feeds himself properly when he's busy with his research! But don't worry. What matters most with this dish is sincerity, not taste. I'll write down a recipe, so could you please deliver it to #p206#?

yes.0: Thank you! Here, please give this #b#t4031111##k to #p206#. And please pass this message along to him—tell him that even if he isn't good at cooking, he must make this dish for his daughter himself.

no.0: Hmm... I find it hard to understand why you would turn down a request like this.

1.0: Ah, you're back! So, what did #p203# say? What? She suggested I follow this #t4031111# and cook a meal for #p506# myself? Goodness, I've never properly cooked a day in my life... Can I really pull this off?

npc.0: Here, please deliver this #t4031111# to #p206#. With this, I'm sure #p506# will open her heart.

item.0: Ah, you're back! So, what did #p203# say? What? She suggested I follow this #t4031111# and cook a meal for #p506# myself? But wait... where is this recipe you speak of?

lost.0: Oh my... Did you lose the recipe I gave you? Sigh... I will write it down for you again, so please be careful not to lose it this time.
